geometry: 14 by 14 canvas with a translucent black field and a one-unit-wide, square-cornered gray square wave. The wave occupies x=2–11 and y=3–11; the field has subtly rounded outer corners. Source wave pixels are RGBA (142,142,142,206), while the field is predominantly (0,0,0,166).
limitations: Outer corner antialiasing is approximated with a half-unit rounded corner. Native and 8x SVG renders were generated and the 8x render was inspected.
